description: This file defines an abstract base class for actors that perform health checks of subsystems within an Akka-based system. It contains methods to handle health status retrieval, updates, and message handling specific to health checking.

classes.name: AbstractHealthCheckingActor
classes.description: An abstract class for actors responsible for checking subsystem health, managing health state, and responding to health requests.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Creates a combined Receive object that handles health retrieval, custom messages, or any other messages.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to handle custom message types.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to trigger health status retrieval logic.

methods.name: updateHealth
methods.description: Updates the current health status and notifies waiting actors.

methods.name: matchRetrieveHealth
methods.description: Defines message handling for RetrieveHealth messages.

methods.name: matchAny
methods.description: Handles any unknown messages by logging and marking them as unhandled.

methods.name: retrieveHealth
methods.description: Adds sender to waiting list and triggers health retrieval.
